The shift in polls come after a hotel expense scandal last month where several Toronto-area PC caucus members came under fire for expensing thousands of dollars for hotel accommodations in the city where they live and work. Ford has said he did not approve of that spending, was not aware of it and ordered members to reimburse taxpayers for those expenses. [...] But that's just one of several scandals in the past year, including Ford's controversial decision in April to purchase, then sell, a private jet. Valentin says the latest survey still shows 72 per cent of Ontarians saying the province is headed in the wrong direction.
